overview.title: The library — what this engine is
overview.what: acquire → hold → serve / find-gaps / grow — the stock the whole project reads from
body: What it is

The library is the corpus the Grammar-of-Meaning project reads: a strong, bias-visible, durably-backed store of primary sources across traditions. It is not a pipeline stage — it is the stock every other engine operates on. Its job: make it easy to locate + acquire the sources we need, from a VARIETY of origins (African / Latin American / Asian / oral / non-English), not just the Anglophone workhorses.
The reflexive turn

The library does not only hold — it audits its own silence. LACUNA names what is missing by set-difference against a NAMED external authority (a clavis), so "missing" stops meaning "a machine didn't recall it" and starts meaning "a named scholarly authority says it exists and we don't hold it."

logic.title: Inputs → engine → outputs
logic.what: the black-box logic statement (every step: input · transform · output · gate)
body: Inputs
(1) a primary text / reading; (2) a coverage gap surfaced by the morphospace atlas; (3) a clavis (external authority enumerating a literature).
Engine

ACQUIRE (CRADLE classify→route→resolve→dedup→gateway; §2.8 Parity fires non-Western with equal priority) → HOLD (sources + L4 passages; dual-store SQLite+Neon) → SERVE (held passages → the method instrument) · FIND-GAPS (LACUNA recall-vs-clavis) · GROW (silences → desiderata → acquire → round-trip closes them).
Outputs
(1) held, chunked passages the instrument codes; (2) a cited gap-map + shopping list; (3) a defensible self-audit (held vs registered; recall vs clavis).
Gate
no memory-enumeration — a silence must be an evidenced discrepancy vs a named authority; every acquisition routes through the gateway (provenance + dedup, §2.7).

corpus.title: The corpus — what we hold
corpus.what: sources · passages — the stock we hold
body: Data

64,871 held as full text  ·  of 373,644 registered  ·  348 silences named

Held = >300 chars of real text (excerpts excluded — a snippet is not full text): 17.4% of registered, across 12.85M passages. The honest 3-part count — registered / held / reference — is first-class here; naming all three is the anti-inflation discipline (corpus_headline_count_matches_db.py guards it from drift).

audit.title: Audit — recall vs clavis (the reflexive rigor)
audit.what: the library measures its own blindness against named authorities
body: The metric

Recall vs clavis = the % of a named authority's enumerated entries for which our corpus holds ≥1 witness. A silence = the residual (authority − holdings), each carrying the authority's citation (a clavis_number) so a third party can check it.
Results — two traditions (the engine is seed-agnostic)

The SAME engine, pointed at two different machine-readable claves:
Syriac (Syriaca.org): RECALL 7.0%  ·  9/128 held
Ethiopic (Gəʿəz) (Beta maṣāḥǝft): RECALL 3.8%  ·  8/210 held

Both hold the canonical/Greek-transmitted fathers (Chrysostom, Nyssa, Cyril…) but are blind to the NATIVE authorial tradition — the §2.8 Anglophone-default blindness, replicated across traditions. Top Syriac silences (acquire first):

  • ʿEnanishoʿ — Syriaca attests 155 works (474)
  • Narsai — Syriaca attests 109 works (650)
  • Jacob of Edessa — Syriaca attests 80 works (113)
  • John of Ephesus — Syriaca attests 62 works (74)
  • Palladius of Aspuna — Syriaca attests 59 works (668)
  • George Warda — Syriaca attests 44 works (504)
  • Jerome — Syriaca attests 35 works (857)
  • Eusebius of Caesarea — Syriaca attests 33 works (480)
Matching is adjudicated

Deterministic candidate-generation (distinctive-token subset) → LLM adjudication (Haiku, temp 0, every verdict logged) rejects false matches (Syriac "Thomas" ≠ Thomas Hobbes; "John Rufus" ≠ Musonius Rufus). The number is defensible because the matcher is auditable, not because it is generous.
The reflexive finding (the clavis has silences too)

Syriaca.org does not enumerate gospel commentaries (0 of 2,824 works; even Ephrem's Diatessaron Commentary is absent). The choice of clavis determines which silences are visible — so gospel-commentary exegesis needs a PRINT clavis (Baumstark / CPG). A validated audit is not one with no blind spots; it is one whose blind spots are named.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.what: the stages, the store, the scripts
body: Stages (LACUNA)

STAGE 0 define reference population (clavis) · STAGE 1 the fill (set-difference) · STAGE 2 measure (recall) · STAGE 5 queue (durable desiderata). Each is a black box: input → transform → output → gate (§2.15).
Store of record

silence_finding (348 rows; 322 carry a clavis URI) — dual-store SQLite + Neon (§2.13). Each silence: type · wall · lifecycle · fill_provenance (endpoint-enumeration vs ai-memory-flagged) · status (identified→…→held/blocked; blocked never closes).
Scripts

fetch_syriaca_authors_clavis.py (Stage 0) · recall_vs_clavis.py (Stage 1→2→5; seed-agnostic, idempotent) · adjudicate_held_matches.py (LLM match adjudication) · export_library_engine_schema_s159.py (this artifact).

gaps.title: Find the gaps (LACUNA)
gaps.what: audit the corpus for what's missing — vs a clavis.
body: Data
Gospels resurrection: 15/26 silences closed by acquisition round-trip. Syriac authors: 120 cited silences (the desiderata list). See the Audit drawer for the recall method.
Priority — the suppressed gospel-reception LACUNA (S168, PI-directed)

The next acquisition frontier, in two strands (LACUNA grain-1: what the corpus never held). Strand 1 — suppressed THEOLOGIES (marginalized ideas/sects): the non-literal Jesus — Ebionite (Jesus as righteous man), Gnostic / Gospel of Thomas (no passion narrative), Arian, and the modern historical-critical + psychological readings (Jefferson Bible, Tolstoy, Strauss, Jung's Red Book) — where the life stays sacred without literal resurrection / atonement (the little-t Jesus). Strand 2 — suppressed VOICES (marginalized people): the Black church (Howard Thurman, the spirituals, Cone), female theologians (womanist; the medieval mystics — Julian, Teresa, Hildegard), non-Western theologians — as Reading-Room glosses on the 4 gospels ('go deeper'). Held-state (S168): already richer than feared — Thurman 407 held, Jung 218, Black theology 78, liberation 87, womanist 56, Julian 17, Tolstoy 14 — so the bottleneck is targeted gap-fill (the spirituals=0, Judas/Philip/Marcion, Armenian + Church-of-East=0) + reception-linkage to gospel passages, not bulk acquisition. Full plan: LWS_next_plan_the_nonliteral_jesus_lacuna_s168. §2.8 bias-visibility applied to Christianity's own erased alternatives.
